cds.title: University of Maryland, College Park Common Data Set 2025-2026 (xlsx)

stats.notes: The Common Data Set residency split reports only in-state and out-of-state; international applicants are included in the out-of-state figures (not broken out). No early decision; non-binding early action (Nov 1). GPA is on a weighted scale (average 4.41, 89% shown as 4.0), so it is not comparable to unweighted GPAs. Competitive admission to Limited Enrollment Programs (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Business) is reviewed separately.

cds_test_policy.notes: The Common Data Set marks SAT/ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted' and says UMD is true test-optional.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (flat undergraduate rate; 23.8% of undergraduates pay more because business/engineering/CS charge differential tuition). The Common Data Set also ticks 'final 2026-2027 costs not yet available', so treat these as estimates. Other costs are miscellaneous personal expenses; the transportation estimate ($1,514) is not included. UMD charges $125 per semester to students needing an I-20/DS-2019. The Common Data Set shows no institutional scholarship or grant aid for nonresident undergraduates
